remarks:
Escape to your own private retreat with this newly finished cabin nestled on 1.95 peaceful acres in Angelica NY, Allegany County.

Set well back from the road and surrounded by mature trees and open fields, this charming cabin offers privacy, comfort, and natural beauty. Perched atop the bank overlooking Angelica Creek, you'll enjoy the relaxing sights and sounds of the gently flowing water and the picturesque wooded landscape beyond.

The inviting covered wraparound deck is the perfect place to sip your morning coffee, unwind after a day of exploring, or simply take in the tranquil surroundings. Spend evenings gathered around the outdoor fire pit under the stars, making memories with family and friends.

Inside, you'll immediately be drawn to the stunning floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, creating a warm and cozy focal point for the open living space. Vaulted ceilings and an abundance of natural light make this 580-square-foot cabin feel surprisingly spacious. The thoughtfully designed galley kitchen complements the cabin's rustic charm with beautiful handcrafted wood countertops while offering modern conveniences including a stainless steel farmhouse sink, dishwasher, stove, microwave, and refrigerator.

The loft comfortably accommodates two full-size beds and an additional bunk providing plenty of sleeping space for guests, while the oversized bathroom offers both comfort and functionality.

Currently operating as the successful "Creekside View Cabin" on VRBO and recognized as a Premier Host, this property presents an outstanding investment opportunity or the perfect personal getaway. The first 12 months of revenue were between $11,000 and $12,000.

Conveniently located just 20 minutes from Houghton University and 20 minutes from Wellsville, you'll enjoy easy access to shopping, dining, and local attractions while still feeling worlds away from it all.

Whether you're searching for a peaceful weekend escape, a profitable short-term rental, or a place to call home, this one-of-a-kind creekside cabin offers an exceptional opportunity to own your own slice of paradise.
